text_markup: The symbol [trash] (plaintext: {curly:trash}) stands for "trash this card". It is used as a self-referential cost in card text, such as "[trash]: Draw 2 cards," which means "Trash this card to draw 2 cards." See {ref:sec_costs} for rules about costs, and {ref:sec_trashing} for rules about trashing cards.
text_plain: The symbol {trash} (plaintext: {trash}) stands for "trash this card". It is used as a self-referential cost in card text, such as "{trash}: Draw 2 cards," which means "Trash this card to draw 2 cards." See section 1.16 for rules about costs, and section 1.19 for rules about trashing cards.
